description: Source code implementing AVX512-accelerated compression and decompression of IQ data using Brain Floating Point (BFP) format, including functions for packing, unpacking, and exponent determination for resource blocks.

methods.name: loadu_epi16_avx512
methods.description: Loads packed 16-bit integers from non-aligned memory using AVX512.

methods.name: compress_prb_avx512
methods.description: Compresses a resource block of 16-bit samples into a packed format using AVX512.

methods.name: iq_compression_bfp_avx512::compress
methods.description: Compresses IQ data into a packed format using AVX512, handling multiple resource blocks.

methods.name: iq_compression_bfp_avx512::decompress
methods.description: Decompresses packed IQ data back into floating point samples using AVX512.
